decisions.decision: Use Rails 8 authentication generator adapted for API-only Bearer tokens
decisions.rationale: Reuses official Rails stack, gives per-device revocation and password reset for free, avoids JWT complexity

decisions.decision: Use provisional User rows for no-account RSVP
decisions.rationale: Single-table upgrade path, no polymorphic GraphQL types, Apollo cache stays normalized

decisions.decision: Use InviteToken table for magic-link invitations
decisions.rationale: Only pattern that supports audit trail, per-token revocation, no-account RSVP, and new-user handoff

decisions.decision: Compute group collection dynamically from members' bgg_collections
decisions.rationale: Existing scope works, ~5-15ms at v1 scale, no write amplification or invalidation complexity

decisions.decision: Use manual 4-state session lifecycle (draft -> invited -> picking -> completed)
decisions.rationale: Fits existing mutation/contract pattern, simple to implement, can add auto-advance later
